reference_sql:
WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per account created from October to December 2025
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
cells AS (  -- one row per cohort account and month offset from 0 to 3
  SELECT c.account_id, c.cohort_month, k.month_offset,
         c.cohort_month + INTERVAL (k.month_offset + 1) MONTH AS next_month
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN range(0, 4) AS k(month_offset)
),
mrr AS (  -- one row per cell, with the account's MRR at that month's end
  SELECT x.cohort_month, x.month_offset, x.next_month, x.account_id,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local), 0) AS mrr
  FROM cells x
  LEFT JOIN subscription_events e ON e.account_id = x.account_id AND e.event_date < x.next_month
  GROUP BY x.cohort_month, x.month_offset, x.next_month, x.account_id
)
SELECT cohort_month, month_offset,
       CASE WHEN next_month > DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE 1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mrr > 0) / COUNT(*) END AS retention_rate
FROM mrr
GROUP BY cohort_month, month_offset, next_month

  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN range(0, 4) AS k(month_offset)
),
mrr AS (  -- one row per cell, with the account's MRR at that month's end
  SELECT x.cohort_month, x.month_offset, x.next_month, x.account_id,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local), 0) AS mrr
  FROM cells x
  LEFT JOIN subscription_events e ON e.account_id = x.account_id AND e.event_date < x.next_month
  GROUP BY x.cohort_month, x.month_offset, x.next_month, x.account_id
)
SELECT cohort_month, month_offset,
       CASE WHEN month_offset < date_diff('month', cohort_month, DATE '2026-01-01')
            THEN AVG(CASE WHEN mrr > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) END AS retention_rate
FROM mrr
GROUP BY cohort_month, month_offset, next_month

WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per account created in the cohort months
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
grid AS (  -- one row per cohort month and month offset from 0 to 3
  SELECT c.cohort_month, g.month_offset, COUNT(*) AS cohort_accounts
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 3) AS g(month_offset)
  GROUP BY c.cohort_month, g.month_offset
),
paying AS (  -- one row per cell, with the cohort accounts whose MRR is above 0 at that month's end
  SELECT g.cohort_month, g.month_offset, g.cohort_accounts,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort c
          WHERE c.cohort_month = g.cohort_month
            AND (SELECT SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) FROM subscription_events e
                 WHERE e.account_id = c.account_id
                   AND e.event_date < g.cohort_month + INTERVAL (g.month_offset + 1) MONTH) > 0) AS paying
  FROM grid g
)
SELECT cohort_month, month_offset,
       CASE WHEN date_diff('month', cohort_month, DATE '2026-01-01') <= month_offset THEN NULL ELSE 1.0 * paying / cohort_accounts END AS retention_rate
FROM paying

other_way.tradeoff: A subquery per cell counts the paying accounts where it is used, which reads simply but runs the sums again for every cell.
